name: Techbot's Memory Core
summary: In Gnomeregan, Tinkmaster Overspark seeks Techbot's Memory Core to study the automaton's corrupted behavior.

sections.title: A Polarized Brain
sections.body: Before Gnomeregan fell, Techbot aided Tinkmaster Overspark and his fellow inventors with devices and knowledge. During the city's fall, an errant electrical discharge jolted Techbot and turned its positronic brain to a hostile negatronic state. Now the automaton wanders Gnomeregan's tainted halls and attacks anyone in sight. Overspark hopes the memory core will help him understand the fault and restore his creation to its senses.

faq.answer: Techbot's Memory Core holds Techbot's data and knowledge. Techbot is the automaton built by Tinkmaster Overspark, and its core records the electrical disruption that corrupted it during Gnomeregan's fall.

aliases: where do i take techbots core
faq.answer: Tinkmaster Overspark wants Techbot's Memory Core. He has taken refuge with fellow exiled gnomes in Ironforge's Tinker Town. He asks adventurers to enter Gnomeregan, disable Techbot and bring back the core so he can attempt repairs.

During Gnomeregan's fall, a stray electrical spark jolted Techbot's positronic brain. The surge polarized it into a negatronic state, turning its personality and protocols from helpful to violently frenzied.

aliases: where to get techbot memory core
faq.answer: The core is recovered from Techbot, which roams Gnomeregan's upper mechanical corridors and entrances in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: For gnomes, Techbot is another casualty of Gnomeregan's fall. The city's ruin claimed brilliant peacetime engineering.
As an engineer, you can see how a single electrical short polarized Techbot's positronic brain and inverted its logic.
